items.title: Ellis Marsalis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 7, 2020
items.q: Most of the rhythm & blues sessions were done, the biggest studio was probably Allen Toussaint’s studio at Sea-Saint. And Allen was the piano player. ... So I was never called to do any of that.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Allen Toussaint wrote that.
There’s so many names that come out of New Orleans. Do you know, what is it about this city, maybe not now, but for all those decades that just fostered so much wonderful music?
